items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: this fellow Homer Eugene would play guitar

ctx.x: Well, after the banjo went out, I used to like to hear Johnny San Siro play guitar. Oh yes, I knew him, yeah, I knew him very well. And this little, this fellow Homer Eugene would play guitar. Oh yeah.
I heard him on banjo and trombone and all.
